title: Pólya Enumeration via Cyclic Group Actions (1 sorry)

problemStatement.formal: Complete 1 sorry in ArithmeticSeriesOQ02OQ02OQ03OQ01.lean: prove the cycle structure theorem for rotation by r in ZMod n acting on ZMod n — the number of cycles equals Nat.gcd n r
problemStatement.plain: Pólya enumeration theorem counts colorings up to symmetry using the cycle index of a group action. The file has 1 sorry: proving that when ZMod n acts on itself by adding r (rotation by r), the number of orbits (cycles) equals gcd(n, r). This is a number theory fact about modular arithmetic.
